name: code-tabs-animate

frames.best_why: The active pnpm tab, all four labels and the full highlighted command block are cleanly visible.

tagline: Package-manager tabs swap install commands inside a dark code panel.
summary: A compact code block with pnpm, npm, yarn and bun tabs; picking one moves the active underline and fades in that manager's install commands, with a copy button on the right.
appearance: A slim dark rounded panel. Four lowercase tab labels sit across the top with a thin white underline under the active one and a small copy icon at the far right. Below, five short lines of small monospace commands, some words tinted blue or purple.
behaviour: Clicking a tab fades and blurs the old snippet out and the new one in while the underline moves to the chosen label. The copy button briefly swaps to a tick after copying.
demo_content: Install commands for pnpm, npm, yarn and bun scaffolding a Vite React app and adding motion and lucide-react.
use_when: Documentation shows one install step for several package managers and readers need to copy the right one.
avoid_when: A single fixed command: the tab bar and copy machinery add height and motion for no gain.
customise: Pass a codes object keyed by tab name plus language and theme names; the tab labels come from those keys, while bar styling and the copy button are internal.
weight_why: Shiki highlights every snippet in the browser on mount, then motion runs a small swap.

a11y.note: Tabs are keyboard operable and focus rings show, but the copy button is icon-only and the animation ignores reduced motion.

issues: The copy control is an unlabelled icon, so its purpose is not announced.
polish_why: Tight code panel with a pleasant blur swap; the icon-only copy control is the weak spot.
title: Code Tabs
